newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. envoy Ross, Israeli prime minister Netanyahu say security is a priority in the region.
- Experts from the Syrian Foreign Ministry to visit Iraq on Monday.
- Yemen seeks to reduce population growth from 3.7 percent a year to 2.5 percent.
- Egypt says exports from free trade zones stood at $212 million in the last seven months.
- Verdict expected next week in the case of two British nurses accused of murdering their Australian colleague in Saudi.
- A Syrian trade and economic team is to go to Iraq this week to sign contracts to export products and goods to Baghdad.
- Damascus expects an official Iraqi request to resume pumping oil through Syria.
- Abu Dhabi emirate to set up a $3.3 billion firm to develop its free trade zone.
